title: Multi-parameter persistence in dynamical systems for maximizing effects of control inputs
summary: We introduce a new topological method to naturally extend a partial function $h \colon X \rightharpoonup [-\infty, \infty]$ on a ``generalization'' of a metric space $X$ equipped with a dynamical system $f \colon X \rightharpoonup X$, to a function $h_f^{\varepsilon\text{-}\ell^p} \colon X \to [-\infty,\infty]$ with parameters $\varepsilon,p$, which allows us to apply existing topological data analysis techniques to functions defined on the whole space.
